page.content:
Danish brick system whose modular plastic pieces built City, Castle, Bionicle, and licensed worlds.

How LEGO connects

  • Character: Ole Kirk Christiansen — Ole Kirk Christiansen founded the Billund workshop and named it LEGO.
  • Faction: The LEGO Group — The LEGO Group designs and manufactures the LEGO system.
  • Work: LEGO City — LEGO City is the evergreen town theme of the brick system.
  • Work: LEGO Star Wars — LEGO Star Wars is the flagship licensed theme of the brick system.
  • Work: The LEGO Movie — The LEGO Movie is the feature that put the brick world on screen.
  • Work: LEGO Castle — LEGO Castle is the medieval fantasy theme of the brick system.
  • Work: LEGO Space — LEGO Space is the classic science-fiction theme of the brick system.
  • Work: BIONICLE — BIONICLE was The LEGO Group's early-2000s story-driven constructible line.
  • Work: NINJAGO — NINJAGO is the long-running ninja theme of the brick system.
  • Work: LEGO Technic — LEGO Technic is the beam-and-pin engineering line beside the System sets.
  • Location: Legoland Billund — Legoland Billund is the original park built from the brick system.
  • Work: LEGO Pirates — LEGO Pirates is the sailing-and-islands theme beside Castle and Space.
  • Work: LEGO Ideas — LEGO Ideas is the fan-to-box theme of the official system.

What is LEGO?

LEGO is the toy system Ole Kirk Christiansen started in Billund and Godtfred Kirk Christiansen turned into the System of Play. Its lore runs through the stud-and-tube brick, the minifigure, theme lines from City and Castle to Star Wars and Bionicle, and films that put those bricks on screen.

Key threads lead to Ole Kirk Christiansen, The LEGO Group, LEGO City, LEGO Star Wars, The LEGO Movie and LEGO Castle.
